                            Contact Us
                        
                        
                                                            
For general inquiries, call 212.310.6600 from Monday–Friday between 9:00 am–5:00 pm or visit our Contact Us page for more information or to submit an inquiry.

                            Getting Here
                        
                        
                    
                                    
                        
                            Help
                        
                        
    For emergencies, call 911.For general questions or to file a noise complaint, contact NYC 311.Found a lost dog or other pet? Reach out to the Animal Care Center (ACC).For matters relating to wildlife, or injured wildlife in the Park, please contact the Urban Park Rangers: 212.360.2774.

                    
                                    
                        
                            Hours
                        
                        
                                                            
Central Park opens at 6:00 am and closes at 1:00 am, 365 days a year.

                                                    
                    
                                    
                        
                            Lost and Found
                        
                        
                                                            
All items found in the Park are turned in to the NYPD Central Park Precinct by the 86th Street Transverse Road. Inquire at 212.570.4820.

                                                    
                    
                                    
                        
                            Park Rules
                        
                        
                                                            
For Park rules and regulations, visit this page.

                                                    
                    
                                    
                        
                            Permits
                        
                        
                                                            
For information regarding permits, events, weddings, and filming, visit this page.

                                                    
                    
                                    
                        
                            Restrooms
                        
                        
    Find a restroom near you by visiting our public restroom map.All bathrooms are free of charge, except for the restroom at the Central Park Zoo, which requires a purchase for access.

                            Wedding
                        
                        
    To book a wedding ceremony outside of the Conservatory Garden, please contact NYC Parks for a permit. 
To learn more about having a wedding in the Conservatory Garden, visit our Wedding Guide.
